name: Bishoujo Ren'ai Mahjong Series 2nd: Shiritsu Houou Gakuen: 2-nen Junjou-gumi
original_name: 美少女恋愛麻雀シリーズ2nd 私立鳳凰学園 2年純情組
source:
In the story mode player controls a young boy who attends a private academy. There he meets different girls. During conversations with them he plays mahjong, and the endings depend on whether he wins or loses in the game.

There are three stories each featuring one of the heroines. But bittersweet story of Megumi Makoto is considered to be main one.

[Edited from [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/S/SLPM-86716.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
在故事模式中，玩家控制一个就读私立学院的小男孩。在那里他遇到了不同的女孩。在与他们交谈时，他打麻将，结局取决于他在游戏中的输赢。

共有三个故事，每个故事都有一位女主角。但诚惠苦乐参半的故事被认为是主要故事。

[编辑自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/S/SLPM-86716.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]]
